description: This file defines the 'LeaveRequest' entity class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a leave request with properties for leave type, application date, associated employee, and leaves. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping and uses traits and external classes.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave request with ORM mappings, including properties for leave type, date applied, employee, and associated leaves, as well as getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type associated with the leave request.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type for the leave request.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date when the leave was applied.

methods.name: setDateApplied
methods.description: Sets the date when the leave was applied.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee who submitted the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an employee to the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the collection of leaves associated with this leave request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the collection of leaves associated with this leave request.
